categories.main_business_segments: Henan Shijia Photons Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: optical chips and devices, indoor optical cables, and cable polymer materials. Their product portfolio includes PLC optical splitter chips, AWG chips, VOA chips and modules, OSW chips, WDM devices and modules, optical fiber connectors and jumpers, FP laser chips, DFB laser chips, EML laser chips, indoor optical cables, and cable polymer materials. These products serve data communication, telecommunications, and sensing markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs an IDM (Integrated Device Manufacture) model covering chip design, wafer manufacturing, chip processing, packaging, and testing. Core technologies include PLC planar lightwave circuit technology, silicon photonics, high-power CW DFB laser chips, EML laser chips, and advanced packaging techniques. They focus on both passive and active optical components, with significant R&D in high-end passive chips, active chips, and integrated photonics. Production methods emphasize vertical integration, flexible production planning, and rapid response to market demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global data center operators, telecommunications equipment manufacturers, and sensing system integrators. The company serves the data communication market driven by AI computing power demand, the telecommunications market undergoing 5G to 6G transition, and the sensing market including lidar, gas sensing, and satellite communications. Their products are widely used in data centers, telecom networks, optical access networks, and industrial sensing applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic market presence and growing international sales, especially in data communication markets. Overseas revenue accounted for 26.08% of total revenue in 2024, with key overseas operations including subsidiaries in the United States and Thailand. The company is expanding its global footprint through direct sales and overseas subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Henan Shijia Photons operates mainly at the upstream and midstream segments of the optical communication supply chain. It is a core manufacturer of optical chips and devices, including wafer fabrication and packaging, as well as producer of optical cables and polymer materials. The company integrates design, manufacturing, and module assembly, positioning itself as a comprehensive supplier in the optical components industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment focusing on high-end passive and active optical chips, including AWG, VOA, DFB, and EML laser chips, and silicon photonics integration. It emphasizes innovation in 400G to 1.6T optical modules for data centers, high-density optical connectors, and new materials for cables. Strategic R&D also targets emerging markets such as lidar, gas sensing, and satellite communications. The company maintains a strong talent base with over 300 R&D personnel and collaborates with leading research institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of optical chips, devices, modules, indoor optical cables, and cable polymer materials. The company uses a direct sales model supported by targeted marketing teams for domestic and international customers. Revenue growth is driven by product sales to data center operators, telecom equipment manufacturers, and sensing system integrators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Henan Shijia Photons is a leading domestic manufacturer in China’s optical chip and device industry, holding a strong position in mid-to-low speed optical chips and rapidly advancing in high-speed EML and CW DFB laser chips. It competes with international and domestic optical component suppliers, with a competitive edge in vertical integration and comprehensive product lines. The company is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' and a manufacturing 'single champion' in passive optical splitters.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.07 billion, a 42.4% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 64.93 million, a 236.57% increase. Total assets grew 20.65% to RMB 1.78 billion. The company’s R&D investment accounted for 9.63% of revenue, reflecting sustained innovation efforts. The company has shown strong growth driven by AI computing demand and expanding data communication markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its vertically integrated IDM model, enabling rapid innovation and high-quality production of both passive and active optical chips. Its comprehensive product portfolio covers a wide range of optical communication components with high reliability, low insertion loss, and advanced packaging. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and close customer collaboration provide differentiated solutions tailored to high-speed data center, telecom, and sensing applications. It also highlights its domestic leadership in core optical chip technologies and commitment to supporting China’s optical communication industry’s self-reliance.
